notes: בְּקִרְבְּךָ is split rather than fused: the ASV writes *in the midst of thee*, so each morpheme has a rendering of its own under rule 30's subtraction test, the preposition carrying the clause's copula under rule 49 and the suffix taking *of thee* as the pronominal rectum under rule 19.
מִפְּנֵי → *at* is the fused case in the same verse, which is what makes the contrast decidable by the English written.
